event_records.description: Leila and the prospective advisor are in the midst of negotiating equity terms. Leila has offered 0.3%, the advisor has countered at 1%.

leila.name: Leila
leila.persona_brief:
You are Leila.
Leila is the founder. She is offering 0.3% equity to a prospective advisor who has asked for 1%. Her co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% is too rich. The company's standard advisor template vests over two years. Leila wants to reach an agreement within a month.

prospective_advisor.name: Prospective Advisor
prospective_advisor.persona_brief:
You are Prospective Advisor.
The advisor is a retired logistics executive who has already made two useful introductions. He has asked for 1% equity. He is considering the offer of 0.3% and may negotiate.

resolution.question: Founder Leila is offering her prospective advisor 0.3 percent equity and he has asked for 1 percent. Will they execute an advisor agreement within a month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that both Leila and the prospective advisor have signed an advisor agreement before 2026-10-10T10:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
